question: The Konark Dance Festival (KDF) has been held at Konark since 1986 between ___________ every year.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1st and 5th December**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Konark Dance Festival (KDF)** has been held at Konark since 1986.
 
• The festival takes place annually between **1st and 5th December**.
 
• This festival is a celebration of classical dance forms of India, showcasing the rich cultural heritage of the country.
